_meta.description: IOM / NASEM / Health Canada DRI compendium keyed by CNF NutrientID. Adult life-stage cells (males / females 19-30, 31-50, 51-70, 71+) plus pregnant / lactating (19-30, 31-50) are fully populated from the published IOM and NASEM tables. Child and infant cells ship as null with status=pending_curation pending a separate curation pass; the loader returns None for null cells so no false DRI percent is ever fabricated.

307.source: NASEM 2019 Sodium and Potassium DRIs, Chapter 7 p. 322.
307.note: Intake above the CDRR is expected to reduce chronic disease risk if reduced; not a tolerable upper limit.

cdrr.source: NASEM 2019 Sodium and Potassium DRIs, Chapter 6 p. 222 (Table 6-2).
cdrr.note: Potassium CDRR is a chronic-disease-risk reduction TARGET — intake at or above the CDRR is expected to reduce risk (opposite direction to sodium's cap).

cdrr.source: NASEM 2019 Sodium and Potassium DRIs, Chapter 7 p. 322.
cdrr.note: Sodium CDRR is a CAP — intake at or above the CDRR is expected to INCREASE risk; reducing intake below the CDRR is protective. Not a tolerable upper limit.
